text:
alex: Heads-up   Need a quick, focused bench probe for the launch post. Goal: smoke + a small stability slice (250 queries). Can runtime run in 48h?

tara: Yep. please list exact artifacts and the runner command so we can package without followups.

alex: Minimal bundle: 1) per-request CSV (req_id, latency_ms, tokens_in, tokens_out, model_tag), 2) aggregate table (p50/p90/p99, avg tokens), 3) warm vs cold heatmap PNG, 4) README with seed link + runner_cmd (redact keys), 5) one quantized trial if available. Success gate: <1% errors and p99 not wildly regressed.

frank: Add: record mean batch size and cache hit rate. Also include any fallback routing events. If quantized p99 > baseline by >15% mark it as "do not use in headline".

alex: Seed file uploaded: https://redwood.co/samples/launch-clarify-250.csv. Baseline model tag: rw-large-v1:2026-03-10. Quantized candidate: rw-large-v1-q4_0. Example runner:
```bash
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $RWD_KEY' \
  -d '{"model":"rw-large-v1:2026-03-10","input_file":"launch-clarify-250.csv","max_tokens":200}'
```
Please redact $RWD_KEY in the packaged runner_cmd.

zoe: tagging runtimebot for scheduling and quantize availability @runtimebot

runtimebot: job scheduled id=jb_3250_mkt_clarify. est runtime 2.6h on staging-gpu-2. q4 kernels present; will log fallback events. Artifacts path: /artifacts/jb_3250_mkt_clarify/.

tara: I'll own the slide packaging if artifacts arrive. marketing wants numbers by EOD+2; we'll gate on the sanity run.

runtimebot: job jb_3250_mkt_clarify completed (2h38m). Artifacts: latency.csv, aggregates.csv, heatmap.png, README.txt, runner_cmd_redacted.txt. Metrics: mean_batch=3.6, cache_rate=10%. Quantized p99 = +16% vs baseline. One fallback event recorded (swapped to rw-medium for 3 requests). No hard failures.

frank: pulling artifacts now. note the quantized delta is slightly above our 15% cutoff. I'll compute exact percentiles and cost_estimates and flag for comms.
\ealex: (typo correction) alex: thanks  frank  include a short caveat: "quantized candidate showed ~16% higher p99 in this staging probe; baseline numbers used in headline, full trace in appendix."

zoe: noted. tara will redact keys and prepare a 1-slide summary + appendix blurb. ETA ~10h.

tara: on it. I'll also add a one-line note for sales: "reference baseline percentiles; quantization shown as in-progress with appendix details."

alex: perfect. closing loop unless SRE wants to review packaging. :thumbsup:
